column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 02（i 10091–10180）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
10091 § streaming § Streaming services offer music and films on demand. § **流媒体**服务按需提供音乐和电影。
10092 § surveillance § CCTV surveillance is common in public places. § 公共场所的闭路电视**监控**很常见。
10093 § update § The app released a new update with better features. § 这款应用发布了一次功能更完善的**更新**。
10094 § virtual § Virtual classrooms make education accessible to more people. § **虚拟**课堂让更多人能够接受教育。
10095 § virus § A computer virus can destroy important files. § 计算机**病毒**可能毁掉重要文件。
10096 § website § The website provides free practice tests. § 这个**网站**提供免费的模拟测试。
10097 § wireless § Wireless technology connects devices without cables. § **无线**技术无需线缆就能连接设备。
10098 § digital divide § The digital divide leaves some communities without internet access. § **数字鸿沟**使一些社区无法接入互联网。
10099 § information § People can obtain information instantly online. § 人们可以在网上即时获取**信息**。
10100 § interactive § Interactive whiteboards make lessons more engaging. § **互动**白板让课堂更有吸引力。
10101 § sophisticated § Sophisticated software can analyse data in seconds. § **精密复杂的**软件能在几秒钟内分析数据。
10102 § technology § Technology has reshaped every aspect of modern life. § **科技**重塑了现代生活的方方面面。
10103 § trend § The trend towards online shopping continues to grow. § 网购**趋势**仍在持续增强。
10104 § biodiversity § Deforestation threatens the biodiversity of the rainforest. § 砍伐森林威胁着雨林的**生物多样性**。
10105 § carbon § Burning fossil fuels releases large amounts of carbon. § 燃烧化石燃料会释放大量**碳**。
10106 § climate § Climate change is one of the greatest challenges of our time. § **气候**变化是我们这个时代最大的挑战之一。
10107 § conservation § Wildlife conservation requires international cooperation. § 野生动物**保护**需要国际合作。
10108 § contaminate § Industrial waste can contaminate local water supplies. § 工业废物会**污染**当地的水源。
10109 § deforestation § Deforestation accelerates soil erosion and flooding. § **砍伐森林**加速了水土流失和洪灾。
10110 § degradation § Soil degradation reduces agricultural productivity. § 土壤**退化**降低了农业生产力。
10111 § drought § The prolonged drought destroyed most of the crops. § 持续的**干旱**毁掉了大部分农作物。
10112 § ecology § Ecology studies the relationship between organisms and their environment. § **生态学**研究生物与其环境之间的关系。
10113 § ecosystem § Coral reefs are among the most fragile ecosystems. § 珊瑚礁是最脆弱的**生态系统**之一。
10114 § emission § Countries agreed to cut greenhouse gas emissions. § 各国同意削减温室气体**排放**。
10115 § endangered § The panda was once on the endangered species list. § 大熊猫曾被列入**濒危**物种名录。
10116 § erosion § Trees help prevent soil erosion on hillsides. § 树木有助于防止山坡的土壤**侵蚀**。
10117 § extinct § Many species will become extinct if habitats are destroyed. § 如果栖息地被破坏，许多物种将会**灭绝**。
10118 § flood § Heavy rainfall caused severe flooding in the region. § 强降雨导致该地区发生了严重的**洪水**。
10119 § fossil fuel § Burning fossil fuels is a major source of air pollution. § 燃烧**化石燃料**是空气污染的主要来源。
10120 § global warming § Global warming is causing sea levels to rise. § **全球变暖**正导致海平面上升。
10121 § greenhouse gas § Carbon dioxide is the most common greenhouse gas. § 二氧化碳是最常见的**温室气体**。
10122 § habitat § Urban expansion destroys natural habitats. § 城市扩张破坏了自然**栖息地**。
10123 § humidity § The high humidity makes the summer heat unbearable. § 高**湿度**让夏日的酷热难以忍受。
10124 § irrigation § Drip irrigation saves water in dry regions. § **滴灌**能在干旱地区节约用水。
10125 § landfill § A huge amount of household waste ends up in landfill sites. § 大量生活垃圾最终被送进**垃圾填埋场**。
10126 § methane § Livestock farming produces significant amounts of methane. § 畜牧业会产生大量**甲烷**。
10127 § mitigate § Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change. § 植树有助于**减轻**气候变化的影响。
10128 § monsoon § The monsoon brings heavy rain to South Asia each year. § **季风**每年都会给南亚带来大量降雨。
10129 § natural disaster § Earthquakes and floods are common natural disasters. § 地震和洪水是常见的**自然灾害**。
10130 § ozone § Chemicals in aerosols once damaged the ozone layer. § 气雾剂中的化学物质曾经破坏过**臭氧**层。
10131 § pollution § Air pollution in big cities harms public health. § 大城市的空气**污染**危害公众健康。
10132 § preserve § We should preserve natural resources for future generations. § 我们应当为子孙后代**保护**自然资源。
10133 § recycle § Households are encouraged to recycle plastic and glass. § 鼓励家庭**回收利用**塑料和玻璃。
10134 § renewable § Renewable energy sources include solar and wind power. § **可再生**能源包括太阳能和风能。
10135 § resilient § Coral reefs are surprisingly resilient to some changes. § 珊瑚礁面对某些变化时，**恢复力**出人意料地强。
10136 § runoff § Agricultural runoff pollutes rivers with fertilisers. § 农业**径流**把化肥带入河流，造成污染。
10137 § sea level § Rising sea levels threaten low-lying coastal cities. § 不断上升的**海平面**威胁着地势低洼的沿海城市。
10138 § solar § Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity. § **太阳能**电池板把阳光转化为电能。
10139 § sustainable § Sustainable farming protects the land for future use. § **可持续**农业保护土地以备将来使用。
10140 § toxic § Toxic chemicals leaked into the river. § **有毒**化学物质泄漏进了河里。
10141 § turbine § Wind turbines generate electricity without emitting carbon. § 风力**涡轮机**发电时不排放碳。
10142 § urbanisation § Rapid urbanisation puts pressure on the environment. § 快速的**城市化**给环境带来压力。
10143 § vegetation § Dense vegetation provides shelter for many animals. § 茂密的**植被**为许多动物提供了栖身之所。
10144 § waste § Reducing food waste is important for the environment. § 减少食物**浪费**对环境很重要。
10145 § watershed § The river's watershed covers several provinces. § 这条河的**流域**覆盖了好几个省份。
10146 § wildlife § The national park is home to a rich variety of wildlife. § 这座国家公园栖息着种类繁多的**野生动植物**。
10147 § renewable energy § Many countries are shifting towards renewable energy. § 许多国家正在转向**可再生能源**。
10148 § carbon footprint § Taking public transport reduces your carbon footprint. § 乘坐公共交通能减少你的**碳足迹**。
10149 § eco-friendly § Eco-friendly packaging is becoming more common. § **环保**包装越来越常见。
10150 § green § Cities are creating more green spaces for residents. § 城市正在为居民打造更多**绿色**空间。
10151 § reforestation § Reforestation projects help restore damaged ecosystems. § **重新造林**项目有助于修复受损的生态系统。
10152 § climate change § Climate change is causing more frequent extreme weather events. § **气候变化**正导致极端天气事件更加频繁。
10153 § recycling § Recycling reduces the amount of waste sent to landfill. § **回收利用**减少了送往填埋场的垃圾量。
10154 § energy § Solar energy is clean and widely available. § **太阳能**清洁且随处可得。
10155 § environment § Protecting the environment benefits everyone. § 保护**环境**对每个人都有益。
10156 § acute § He was admitted to hospital with acute chest pain. § 他因**急性**胸痛住进了医院。
10157 § antibiotic § Doctors warn against the overuse of antibiotics. § 医生警告不要滥用**抗生素**。
10158 § anxiety § Exam pressure often causes anxiety in students. § 考试压力常常让学生产生**焦虑**。
10159 § bacteria § Some bacteria are harmful, while others are beneficial. § 有些**细菌**有害，有些则有益。
10160 § cancer § Early detection greatly improves the chances of beating cancer. § 早期发现能大大提高战胜**癌症**的几率。
10161 § cardiac § Cardiac arrest requires immediate emergency treatment. § **心脏**骤停需要立即进行急救。
10162 § chronic § Chronic diseases such as diabetes require lifelong management. § 糖尿病等**慢性**疾病需要终身管理。
10163 § clinical § The drug is now in clinical trials. § 这种药物目前正处于**临床**试验阶段。
10164 § depression § Depression affects millions of people worldwide. § **抑郁症**影响着全世界数百万人。
10165 § diabetes § Obesity is a major risk factor for type 2 diabetes. § 肥胖是 2 型**糖尿病**的主要风险因素。
10166 § diagnosis § An early diagnosis can save a patient's life. § 早期**诊断**可以挽救患者的生命。
10167 § disease § Heart disease is a leading cause of death worldwide. § **心脏病**是全球主要的死因之一。
10168 § disorder § Sleep disorders are common among office workers. § 睡眠**障碍**在上班族中很常见。
10169 § dosage § Never exceed the recommended dosage of a medicine. § 切勿超过药物的推荐**剂量**。
10170 § epidemic § The epidemic spread rapidly across the country. § **疫情**在全国迅速蔓延。
10171 § genetic § Some diseases have a genetic component. § 有些疾病具有**遗传**因素。
10172 § healthcare § Universal healthcare is the goal of many governments. § 全民**医疗保健**是许多政府的目标。
10173 § immunity § Vaccination builds immunity against certain viruses. § 接种疫苗能建立对某些病毒的**免疫力**。
10174 § inflammation § Inflammation is the body's response to injury or infection. § **炎症**是身体对损伤或感染的反应。
10175 § intervention § Early intervention can prevent many health problems. § 早期**干预**可以预防许多健康问题。
10176 § medication § She takes medication for high blood pressure. § 她服用**药物**治疗高血压。
10177 § mental health § Employers are paying more attention to mental health. § 雇主越来越关注**心理健康**。
10178 § mortality § Infant mortality has fallen dramatically. § 婴儿**死亡率**已大幅下降。
10179 § nutrition § Good nutrition is essential for children's growth. § 良好的**营养**对儿童的成长至关重要。
10180 § obesity § Childhood obesity has become a public health crisis. § 儿童**肥胖**已成为一场公共卫生危机。
